commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

version.description: The version to update to; absent, the channel's newest, or the pinned version.

artefactPath.description: The path of an artefact of that version on the environment's machine, from a local client session only: the desktop's bundled one, or update apply's.

when.description: When an asked-for update drains: idle (under the idle rules and the deferral cap, as Update now and a newer client's offer do) or now (at once, cutting running runs at the drain's cap).
